facts.fact: The lockhouse's slit window has a warped slatted shutter that lets a stripe of the lane be seen from inside.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Rohan watch the torches 'through the slats' from the grain store.

facts.fact: A sentry throws Rohan his coat, the borrowed brown pattu and, in the coat pocket, his gloves when he asks, on the grounds that Varun needs him breathing.
facts.why: needed because ch25 had them strip his coat and pattu, and the beat requires him to wrap Meera in both and stay gloved.

facts.fact: Rohan's father once told him, when drinking, that his grandfather was found at the thaw with his gloves laid one on the other on a flat stone beside him. Rohan has never worked out why.
facts.why: a small odd detail for the grandfather truth-telling beat; can pay off later with the Old Bargain (S4) without revealing it.

facts.fact: Dilan once laughed in the middle of his oath at the post and was given a week of latrine duty, which he spent singing the hymn. Ila once paced the family kitchen at age seven and found it a hand shorter than the builder claimed; she named a ridge 'Tamar's Shoulder' after a cook who fed her.
facts.why: needed to supply the truths Rohan tells (Dilan's laugh, Ila's measuring).

facts.fact: The grey-bearded officer wears a plain slate cloak without a shoulder bell and rides a tall grey. He orders the torches lowered; the red-moustached patrol captain obeys. Nimmi stands on her step and studies his face. Rohan does not learn his name.
facts.why: needed for the C18/S6 payoff beat without naming Tej.

facts.fact: Rohan's 'I won't ask you anything else' makes the rope hum low and level, a promise made while bound. His fingertips chill as his ch16 promise not to let her fall begins to press while Meera slips.
facts.why: needed to show the promise binding his body to hers, per the beat's romance change and the F149 promise rule.
